description: Real Apple Notes hashtag tags from a script, on macOS

metadata.description: Create, repair, list and remove real Apple Notes tags — including non-ASCII ones

plugins.name: apple-notes-tagger
plugins.description: Create, repair, list and remove real Apple Notes hashtag tags on macOS — the inline objects that show up in the Tags sidebar and drive Smart Folders. Fixes hashtags stuck as plain text after AppleScript or pasting, adds tags in bulk (Chinese/Japanese/Korean included), and can auto-tag untagged notes.
